llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Notifications screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Notifications screen is defined as NotificationsScreen and registered under the key 'Notifications' in the createNativeStackNavigator screens map.
evidence: screens: { Home: HomeScreen, Notifications: { screen: NotificationsScreen, ... } }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must model filter as an optional navigation param for the notifications screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The route params type is declared as { filter?: string } (optional string) on NotificationsScreen.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must default filter to all when the param is absent.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: filter defaults to 'all' via the nullish coalescing expression when route.params?.filter is absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the normalized filter value in the screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The resolved filter value is interpolated directly into the rendered Text component.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object, and the result is passed to createStaticNavigation which is then rendered as <Navigation />.
